title: Music Open Mic @ Hops On Birch
event_description: Weekly musician-focused open mic featuring local talent in a supportive and intimate craft beer bar environment. Hosted by Beth Pickens in a chill atmosphere welcoming all skill levels.
event_venue_information:
About Hops On Birch

Hops On Birch stands as Flagstaff's premier craft beer destination since 2012. This downtown venue features 32 constantly rotating taps focused on local Arizona breweries and hard-to-find craft selections from across the nation.

Music and Entertainment

The bar hosts regular live music events including weekly open mic nights on Wednesdays and live performances on Saturdays and the first Friday of each month. The venue provides a welcoming and supportive environment for local musicians to showcase their talents.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The venue offers a dog-friendly patio and allows outside food making it perfect for pairing craft beverages with food truck offerings or takeout. With dart boards games and cozy seating the space encourages community gathering. The rustic-chic backdrop creates an industrial living room vibe with ambient lighting perfect for relaxing evenings downtown.

title: Open Mic Night @ Drinking Horn Mead Hall
event_description: Monthly open mic for musicians held every second Tuesday at Flagstaff's first meadery. Original music encouraged in a welcoming community atmosphere. No comedy allowed - musicians only.
event_venue_information:
About Drinking Horn Meadery

Born in the pines of Flagstaff in 2017 Drinking Horn Meadery is the city's first and only mead house. The meadery focuses on creating environmentally responsible beverages using local ingredients and sustainable practices with a dedication to water conservation.

The Mead Hall

The Mead Hall serves as Flagstaff's community gathering space offering handcrafted mead in small batches using authentic recipes inspired by one of mankind's earliest libations. The venue features a warm welcoming atmosphere perfect for creative expression.

Events and Entertainment

Regular events include monthly open mic nights every second Tuesday Celtic music every Thursday from 7-9 PM and weekly trivia nights. The venue has built a strong community around live music poetry nights and spiritual gatherings. Hours are Sunday-Thursday 11am-10pm and Friday-Saturday 11am-11pm.

title: Musicians Open Mic @ AWA Kava Bar
event_description: Weekly open mic specifically for musicians held every Friday evening. Performers showcase their talents in a unique alcohol-free environment serving kava coffee and tea in a cozy community-focused space.
venue_address: 218 S San Francisco St Flagstaff AZ 86001
event_venue_information:
About AWA Kava Bar

AWA Kava Bar opened in late 2019 as Flagstaff's first and only kava bar introducing Northern Arizona to traditional Pacific Island kava culture. The venue serves locally roasted coffee kava beverages and botanical teas in a welcoming sober-friendly environment.

Community and Events

The bar hosts weekly open mic nights for musicians every Friday at 7:30 PM along with chess nights craft nights and other community events. The space has become a gathering place for those seeking social connection without alcohol with many regular customers forming a tight-knit community.

Atmosphere

With a homey interior decorated with local art board games and study areas AWA provides a chill cafe-style atmosphere. Open Sunday-Thursday 6:30am-10pm and Friday-Saturday 6:30am-11pm the venue welcomes everyone looking for a relaxing space to connect and enjoy live music.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Wheeler Park / Flagstaff Mall
event_description: Weekly bluegrass jam session sponsored by Flagstaff Friends of Traditional Music. Practice session 11am-noon followed by main jam noon-1pm. Summer location at Wheeler Park downtown winter at Flagstaff Mall by fireplace.
venue_address: Downtown Flagstaff / Flagstaff Mall Flagstaff AZ 86001
event_venue_information:
About Flagstaff Friends of Traditional Music

FFOTM is dedicated to showcasing the best in folk and acoustic music in Arizona and beyond. The organization sponsors weekly acoustic music jams and hosts the annual Pickin' in the Pines Bluegrass Festival.

Weekly Bluegrass Jam

Open to the public with a musical focus on bluegrass though other folk music forms are welcome. Musicians should have knowledge of basic chords and ability to keep steady beat. Listeners are always welcome. The jam uses a Google group to share videos and instructional materials of songs played weekly.

Format and Etiquette

Practice session from 11am-noon for those wanting to brush up on specific tunes followed by main jam noon-1pm. Jamming etiquette is required. Participants bring songs to share based on oral tradition. Songs with minimum chords in folk old-time and bluegrass genres work best. Check the Meetup site for current location information updated weekly.

title: Live Music @ Dark Sky Beer Garden
event_description: Weekly live music series featuring different local and regional musicians every Friday evening. Free entry performances in the outdoor beer garden under string lights and stars.
event_venue_information:
About Dark Sky Brewing

Named in honor of Flagstaff's designation as the world's first International Dark Sky Place Dark Sky Brewing crafts unique beer selections inspired by the beauty of the night sky. The brewery features both an indoor taproom and outdoor beer garden.

Beer Garden and Live Music

The outdoor beer garden provides an intimate setting under string lights and stars for weekly live music every Friday evening from 6-8 PM. Different artists perform each week ranging from solo acoustic acts to full bands. The brewery also hosts special acoustic emo nights and the annual Dark Sky Music and Arts Festival.

Community Events

In addition to regular live music the brewery hosts trivia nights bingo yoga sessions and seasonal celebrations. The beer garden features out-of-this-world pizza food options and a rotating selection of craft beers. Open with ample street parking available downtown.
